summary: Implemented a compact visible_text extraction policy that prioritizes visible interactive elements, nearby container text, and headings while avoiding sensitive form values by default. Added a note documenting the policy and updated the notes index.
notes: Key change is in `src/browser/observe.rs` where the JS extractor now builds a de-duplicated, capped set of context snippets and skips form/control values and contenteditable text. Notes captured in `notes/2026-02-11-obs-003-visible-text.md`.
